_description: Enters long when 1m close breaks above the 20-candle SMA of highs AND ATR/close ≥ 0.1% (filters flat/illiquid markets). Stop = entry − 1×ATR, target = entry + 2×ATR, giving 2:1 gross R:R. Most active in trend-acceleration phases and during volatility spikes.
_exit: TP = entry + 2×ATR; SL = entry − 1×ATR; timeout = 120 min
_cost_model: fee_rate 0.1%/side + slippage 0.05%/side = 0.31% round-trip; TP distance = 2×ATR (typically 0.2–0.8% at BTC volatility)
